cues.en: In this part of Let's Build a Chatbot, we are going to look a little more into the Blazor server again, and about the reasoning on how we get there.
cues.zh: 這個打造聊天機器人的單元，要繼續深入 Blazor Server，看看如何取得推理內容。

cues.en: So reasoning works pretty much the same as the function calling, in that whenever we look into a response back,
cues.zh: 推理的處理方式與函式呼叫很相似，因為查看回應時，

cues.en: like we had the content of function calls, we also have the content back of reasoning.
cues.zh: 除了函式呼叫 Content，也會有推理 Content。

cues.en: And the reasoning is just a piece of text here that we get back, and then we can show it. So there's nothing much to it.
cues.zh: 推理在這裡就是一段回傳文字，直接顯示即可，沒有太複雜的地方。

cues.en: So whenever we get our response back, where the reasoning is also in, and remember, the only way we can get reasoning back
cues.zh: 所以取得回應時，推理也會包含在其中。別忘了，唯一能取得推理摘要的方式，

cues.en: is if we use responses API. If we use normal chat client, we will not get a response back, and that part of the system will not be there.
cues.zh: 是使用 Responses API。如果使用一般 ChatClient，就不會取得這部分回應。

cues.en: You can still run, but it would simply never give any of that type of content back to you.
cues.zh: 程式仍能正常執行，只是永遠不會回傳那種類型的 Content。

cues.en: So in our calls, we will be able to find it here in the response as well.
cues.zh: 因此在這裡，也能從回應找到推理資料。

cues.en: And whenever we want to show it, we just have a small Blazor component here
cues.zh: 想顯示時，使用這個小型 Blazor 元件，

cues.en: that needs the content of the system, and it's just simply going to all content, and if that content is a text reasoning content,
cues.zh: 傳入 Content，接著遍歷所有內容，如果類型是 TextReasoningContent，

cues.en: and that text reasoning is actually something, because you can get text reasoning contents back that are actually empty,
cues.zh: 而且裡面真的有文字，因為有時候會取得空的推理內容，

cues.en: meaning it didn't think about anything, so there's no reason to show it.
cues.zh: 表示沒有可顯示的思考摘要，也就沒必要呈現。

cues.en: So that's the reason why I'm taking that out of here.
cues.zh: 這就是在這裡把空內容排除的原因。

cues.en: And then I'm just showing that output, and again, we can see it up here.
cues.zh: 然後直接顯示輸出，上面的畫面就看得到。

cues.en: You can see it comes back as markdown often, so if you want to make it not just okay, but very pretty,
cues.zh: 它經常以 Markdown 回傳，因此如果希望不只是堪用，而是更漂亮，

cues.en: of course you would need to add some markdown interpreter here in order to show it.
cues.zh: 當然需要加入 Markdown 呈現工具。

cues.en: We can also see that a system can think multiple times, so it thought before it made the tool call, and then it thought some more after the tool call.
cues.zh: 也可以看到，系統可能思考多次，例如工具呼叫前先思考，取得工具結果後再思考。

cues.en: So there can be multiple of these back into the system.
cues.zh: 因此同一輪可能有多段推理回傳。

cues.en: So that is actually everything that is to it in order to do this.
cues.zh: 這就是實作所需的全部內容。

cues.en: During streaming, reasoning will actually stream back, and that can be a bit more troublesome, but we'll take that in the next video. See you there.
cues.zh: 串流時，推理也會逐步回傳，處理上稍微麻煩一些。下一支影片再介紹，到時見。
